summary: Enterprise Suite AC-13 local in-memory service harness composes HR, Payroll, Accounting, Enterprise Suite storage adapters, and the Suite Workflow queue so real app-layer envelopes can be recorded in-process for later cloud-integration rehearsal while durable/cloud/runtime capabilities remain explicit non-claims.

findings: The harness is a thin composition seam over existing in-memory adapter ports and app envelopes; it avoids duplicate orchestration logic and delegates validation to the child services.
Snapshot and capability records are deterministic, bounded, and side-effect free beyond process-local in-memory stores.
The seam provides a rehearsal target for later cloud listener, routing, tenancy, and storage work without claiming those runtime integrations now.
Capability flags keep durable storage, Postgres/RLS, listener, child calls, Workflow engine, broker, filing/disbursement rails, cloud deployment, and runtime audit emission false.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Tests fail if cross-service envelope metadata is not persisted/queued, aggregate counts drift, capability flags overclaim cloud/runtime behavior, or duplicate store errors are swallowed.
findings: Positive cross-service metadata recording and negative duplicate-idempotency handling are both covered.
A single EnterpriseLocalInMemoryHarness exposes named record_* methods, capabilities, and snapshot counts aligned with the service seams.
Focused harness tests/clippy, Enterprise Suite package-group tests/clippy, 23-package enterprise regression tests/clippy, fmt, data_class scan, and quality-marker scan passed.

F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: The process-local harness proves cross-service envelope compatibility before listener, durable storage, Workflow engine, broker, filing/disbursement, and cloud slices exist.
rejected_reasons: A deployed listener would require auth, tenancy, network, observability, rollback, and SLO evidence not present in this slice.
Cloud storage or Workflow broker wiring would make unproven durability/runtime claims and expand blast radius before the local seam is validated.

findings: No secrets, auth bypass, network listener, child service client, provider SDK, or external storage are introduced.
Stored/queued records are metadata-only adapter records derived from existing app/domain validation paths and are process-local.

F8_performance.regression_baseline: Fixed-size test workflow records five service metadata writes and one queue dispatch in process memory; no network, filesystem, database, or broker I/O exists.

findings.summary: Harness operations are direct adapter calls over bounded in-memory vectors/maps; later production performance must be re-evidenced when durable/cloud backends are attached.
